snippet.title: Monari Station Trailer - VAINSANE Fridays #1
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #1 — Monari Station

A short psychological horror visual novel about a late-night commute that slowly becomes… wrong.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Releasing on Mar 13, 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4417000/Monari_Station/
